episodes.title: Ein Platz in der Welt
episodes.summary: Helene and Elisabeth travel to meet Emperor Franz, who is expected to ask for Helene's hand. At the party, he stuns everyone with a surprise decision.

episodes.title: Die Ankunft
episodes.summary: Elisabeth arrives in Vienna for her wedding. Soon enough she faces palace intrigue while Franz attempts to protect his country from going to war.

episodes.title: Die Hochzeit
episodes.summary: Elisabeth marries Franz, and the royal family gets a taste of her rising popularity. Sophie's former lover attends the wedding and discovers a secret.

episodes.title: Die Jagd
episodes.summary: Sophie and the council push for military action, but Franz refuses to engage. Elisabeth upsets the czar's son, leading to severe political consequences.

episodes.title: Die Schuhe
episodes.summary: Maximilian gathers support for an evil plan while Elisabeth's well-intended gesture backfires, leading her to befriend the dubious maid, Leontine.

episodes.title: Der Gott, den man die Freiheit nennt
episodes.summary: Elisabeth spends her time partying with Maximilian while Franz is desperate to reconcile with her. Leontine gets herself into a precarious situation.

episodes.title: Ein Thronfolger
episodes.summary: Pregnant with her second child, Elisabeth is under pressure to provide a male heir to the throne. An incident occurs during a state visit.

episodes.title: Der Traum
episodes.summary: Franz sends Maximilian on a diplomatic mission to make an ally of Napoleon III. Sophie schemes to sideline Elisabeth and take charge of her children.

episodes.title: Ein Brief der Kaiserin
episodes.summary: Elisabeth embarks on a charm offensive across Lombardy-Venetia. Franz gives Maximilian an opportunity to prove his loyalty.

episodes.title: Die Sterne am Tag
episodes.summary: As Leontine asks Alexander to abscond together, he makes a shocking discovery. A visit to Hungary brings tragedy to Franz and Elisabeth.

episodes.title: Der Wald in uns
episodes.summary: Seeking an escape, Elisabeth retreats to her family in Bavaria. Sophie seizes the moment to procure a better match for Franz.

episodes.title: Alles was wir tun können
episodes.summary: As the Austrian Empire plunges into war, Elisabeth fights to keep her family together. Sophie discovers the consequences of her actions.
